new_activity.body: Replies close the project picker The new default removes the picker when an automatic update calls renderSessionListFromCache() directly. Expand prior turns in the detailed sidebar, then open “Move to project” before the report request finishes. Both report callbacks still call the renderer directly, so the reply closes the picker while the user is choosing a project. new_activity.body: Sidebar scrolling shows blank space Open “Move to project” from a topbar-title long-press, then scroll a sidebar with more than 80 sessions. The picker is anchored outside .session-list, so scrolling the list does not close it. The new _repaintSidebarForBackgroundChurn() call skips the row rebuild while that picker remains open.
